name: Temper
description: The person's temper in view from Orca: active goals read through the temper API on a credential borrowed from the temper CLI.

settings.title: Temper context
settings.description: The context ref the panel reads active goals from, such as @me/temper.

settings.title: Temper API origin
settings.description: Override for the temper API origin. Leave unset to use the origin the temper CLI is configured for (TEMPER_API_URL, else [cloud] api_url in its config), so the token and the API always come from the same deployment.
